I was going to PM you about this, but seeing as you've posted it here, I'll say this;

This feels more like a supplement then a standalone article. Like a testing log on a larger SCP. It's not horrible, but I don't think it's that great either. But it does get the job done, but execution-wise, it just feels more like a chore to go through.

item.title: Squid Ispolin
item.content:encoded:
This is the second GRU-P format ever, and a tiny bit of a format screw (with regards to the ending). I couldn't get a good way to work that ending of Nikolaev defecting into the normal version of the format, so I went with this.

This is as much a story about kaiju as it is about the end of the Cold War and the Soviet Union - note that I don't say the GRU-P itself has been dissolved entirely, only that they are being restructured. (And don't need/want to trick the Americans into nuking themselves)

In case it isn't obvious, both of Dragonov's letters are form letters, only barely edited to refer to the project at hand. If they seem aloof or general, that is the idea.

Thanks to everyone who looked at this in draft form, including CaptainKirby, ARD and DrChandra.

EDIT: Turns out I posted this on my one-year anniversary of making a wikidot account and joining the site. Neat.

If you liked this thing and would like to read some comments about it, or check out other things I've written, head to my author page for more!
